newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - State of Tennessee.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - State of Tennessee.

text.p: SUMMARY NOTICE OF SALE
State of Tennessee
$172,805,000* General Obligation Bonds, 1997 Series A

$25,000,000* General Obligation Bonds, 1997 Series B The Funding Board (the Funding Board'') of the State of Tennessee (the State'' e sealed bids in the Executive Conference Room, Ground Floor, State Capitol, Nashville, Tennessee, or at the offices of Alex. Brown & Sons, Inc., Financial Advisor to the State, 10th Floor, 1290 Avenue of the Americas, New York, New York, until 9:30 A.M. (Central Daylight Savings Time)/ 10:30 A.M. (Eastern
Daylight Savings Time), on
(or at such later time or date announced via Bloomberg Financial Markets at least twenty-four (24) hours in
advance) for the purchase of $172,805,000* principal amount of General Obligation Bonds, 1997 Series A (the Series A Bonds'') and $25,000,000* principal amount of General
Obligation Bonds, 1997 Series B (the Series B Bonds'' and, together with the Series A Bonds, the
Bonds''), of

State. The Bonds will be direct general obligations of the State, for the payment of which as to both principal and interest the full faith and credit of the State is pledged, and are additionally secured as described in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds will be dated May 1, 1997, will bear interest payable November 1, 1997 and semiannually each May 1 and November 1 thereafter, and will be subject to redemption upon the terms and conditions set forth in the Official Notice of Sale. The Series A Bonds will mature on May 1 in each of the years 1998 through 2017, both inclusive, and the Series B Bonds will mature on May 1 in each of the years 2000 through 2027, both inclusive, in principal amounts specified by or determined in accordance with the Official Notice of Sale, and either as serial bonds, or as sinking fund installments and final maturities of up to two term bonds per series, as may be designated by the successful bidders as described in the Official Notice of Sale. The Funding Board reserves the right to increase or decrease the annual and total principal amounts of the Series A Bonds and Series B Bonds before the date of sale, as described in the Official Notice of Sale. In addition, the Funding Board reserves the right to increase or decrease the annual and total principal amounts of the Series B Bonds after bids have been received and adjust the purchase price
proportionately, as described in the Official Notice of Sale. The Bonds are issuable as fully registered bonds in principal amounts of $5,000 or any integral multiple

thereof, and initially will be registered only in the name of Cede & Co., as nominee of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC''), which will act as securities depository for the Bonds. Beneficial ownership interests in

the Bonds will be available to purchasers in book-entry form, and purchasers of beneficial ownership interests will not receive physical delivery of Bond certificates, except under limited circumstances as described in the Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Bonds. Delivery of the Bonds to DTC is expected on or about May 21, 1997. Bidders shall specify the rate or rates of interest which the Bonds shall bear in multiples of one-eighth (1/8) or one-twentieth (1/20) of one percent (1%). The interest rate specified for the Bonds of any maturity of a series of Bonds shall not exceed the interest rate specified for the Bonds of any other maturity of such series by more than two percent (2%). Any number of interest rates may be named, but the rate of interest on the Bonds of each separate maturity of a series of Bonds must be the same single rate for all Bonds of that maturity of such series from their date to such maturity date. A bid for the purchase of less than an entire series of Bonds or which specifies split or

supplemental interest rates will not be considered. A bid for a price less than the Revised Aggregate Principal Amount (defined in the Official Notice of Sale) of the Series A Bonds will not be considered. A bid for a price less than 99% of the Revised Aggregate Principal Amount of the Series B Bonds will not be considered. A bidder may bid on both or either series of Bonds. A separate bid is required for each series of Bonds. In addition to the price bid, the

successful bidder(s) must pay accrued interest from May 1, 1997 to the date of payment of the purchase price. All bids must be unconditional. The Funding Board intends to award each series of Bonds before the close of business on the day of sale to the responsive bidder(s) complying with the terms of the

Official Notice of Sale and offering to purchase all of the Bonds of such series at the lowest true interest cost to the State (based on the Revised Amounts described in the Official Notice of Sale), calculated as provided in the Official Notice of Sale. The approving opinion of Hawkins, Delafield & Wood, New York, New York, relating to each series of Bonds will be furnished in reasonable quantity to the respective
successful bidder. In order to assist bidders in complying with Rule 15c-12, the State will execute and deliver a written Continuing Disclosure Undertaking to provide annual financial

information, operating data and notices of certain events. A description of the Continuing Disclosure Undertaking is set forth in the Preliminary Official Statement and will be set forth in the final Official Statement. Execution and

delivery of the Continuing Disclosure Undertaking will be a condition precedent to the obligations of the successful bidder(s) to take up and pay for the Bonds. Copies of the Preliminary Official Statement, and copies of the Official Notice of Sale and Bid forms that must be used for the purchase of the Bonds, may be obtained from the

Division of Bond Finance, Suite 1600, James K. Polk Office Building, Nashville, Tennessee 37243-0273 (615-741- 4272) (E-Mail: abutterw@mail.state.tn.us); or from Alex. Brown & Sons, Inc., 6201 Fairview Road, Suite 201,
Charlotte, NC 28210 (704-552-6240), Attention: Joe Niggel. Reference should be made to the Official Notice of Sale for additional information related to the Bond details,
security, authority, form of bid and methods of submittal, award, right of rejection, good faith deposit and purchase price, delivery, Cusip numbers, and other matters. Dated: April 30, 1997
FUNDING BOARD OF THE STATE OF TENNESSEE
By: W.R. Snodgrass
Comptroller of the Treasury
Secretary of the Funding Board of the State of Tennessee
(From The Bond Buyer)
